Metadata.title: Shahbaz Dental Clinic | Samundri
Metadata.description: Explore sample dental services and try the appointment-booking demonstration for Shahbaz Dental Clinic in Samundri.

Home.title: A clearer path to a healthier smile
Home.description: Explore everyday dental care and try a simple appointment journey designed around comfort, clarity, and respect.
Home.demoDescription: Images, dentist profiles, availability, and booking confirmations are sample content until verified by the clinic.
Home.servicesDescription: Browse common reasons people visit a dentist. A clinician must assess you before recommending treatment.
Home.dentistsDescription: These demonstration profiles show how verified clinic staff may appear here later.
Home.careDescription: The future clinic experience will keep choices clear and collect only the information needed for your visit.
Home.careOneDescription: Begin with your concern and the questions that matter to you.
Home.careTwoDescription: Use plain language for options, preparation, and next steps.
Home.careThreeDescription: Keep personal details out of public pages and collect only what is needed.
Home.hygieneDescription: Published procedures will be verified by the clinic before launch. The final site will explain instrument processing, surface cleaning, and protective practices in clear language.
Home.stepsTitle: From choice to confirmation in six short steps
Home.locationDescription: The exact street address and directions will be added only after clinic verification.
Home.urgentTitle: This website is not an emergency-response service
Home.urgentDescription: For severe bleeding, facial swelling that affects breathing, major injury, or another serious emergency, seek appropriate local emergency care now.
Home.finalDescription: Use sample information to see how booking will work. Nothing is sent or reserved yet.

Services.title: Dental care, explained simply
Services.description: Explore example services that may be offered after clinic review. This information is general and is not a diagnosis.
Services.demoDescription: Names, durations, and availability are illustrative and must be confirmed by Shahbaz Dental Clinic before launch.
Services.disclaimerDescription: A dentist must assess your individual needs before recommending care. Results and appointment length can vary.
Services.closingDescription: Choose Dental consultation in the booking demonstration and select No preference for the dentist.

Dentists.title: A future home for verified dentist profiles
Dentists.description: These synthetic portraits and sample details demonstrate the planned directory. They do not represent current clinic staff.
Dentists.demoDescription: Names, interests, languages, and working days below are demonstration content—not verified professional information.
Dentists.noPreferenceDescription: Choose No preference and the future system can match you with an eligible available dentist.

Booking.title: Book an appointment
Booking.description: Try the planned booking journey with sample availability. No real appointment will be created.
Booking.demoDescription: This form stays in your browser and does not contact the clinic, reserve a time, or save information to MongoDB.
Booking.serviceHelp: Select the example service that best matches the kind of visit you want to discuss.
Booking.dentistHelp: Choose a demonstration dentist or let the future clinic system assign an eligible dentist.
Booking.noPreferenceDescription: Match me with an eligible available dentist
Booking.timeHelp: These dates and times are examples and do not show real clinic availability.
Booking.detailsHelp: Use sample details only. This demonstration does not save or send them.
Booking.reviewHelp: Check your sample choices. Submitting completes only this on-screen demonstration.
Booking.consent: I understand this is a demonstration and does not create an appointment.
Booking.requiredDentist: Choose a dentist or No preference to continue.
Booking.requiredMobile: Enter a sample Pakistani mobile number.
Booking.invalidEmail: Enter a valid sample email address or leave it blank.
Booking.requiredConsent: Confirm that you understand this is only a demonstration.
Booking.confirmationDescription: No appointment was created, no time was reserved, and no message was sent. The final booking system will show a real reference here after verification.

Footer.summary: A bilingual dental-care and appointment demonstration for the Samundri community.
Footer.demonstration: This website currently uses sample content and does not create real appointments.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you requested is unavailable in this demonstration.
